claim: For the Heawood graph \(H\), presented as the incidence graph of the Fano plane with its shortest-path metric, \(\dim_{\mathbb F_2}\operatorname{MH}_{3,4}(H;\mathbb F_2)=336\).
integrity: All chain counts, boundary maps, rank computations, and the nongeodetic witness are reconstructed by the included standalone verifier from the stated graph definition.
scientific limitations: Exact only for the Heawood graph in bidegree (3,4) over F_2; no integral, torsion, other-bidegree, or family-wide claim.
title: The first off-diagonal magnitude homology of the Heawood graph has mod-2 rank 336
